# k-anonymizer

> Check k-anonymity of tabular data over quasi-identifiers and find minimal full-domain generalisation levels with bounded suppression Python package `trysac-k-anonymizer`, import name `k_anonymizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
